programme.desc: This is a story of a young boy and a girl who fall in love with each other but decide to discontinue their relationship for the happiness of their respective families who are against their love.

programme.title: The Making Of Pk
programme.desc: Watch behind the scenes and meet the cast and crew of the movie.

programme.title: The Making Of Mubarakan
programme.desc: Watch behind the scenes and meet the cast and crew of the movie.

programme.title: Khandani Shafakhana
programme.desc: Babita Bedi working as a medical representative and the only earner in the house. She has to run a fertility clinic for six months in order to sell it or else she will lose everything.

programme.title: Hurdang
programme.desc: Back in 1990s, an aspiring IAS starts a rebellion against the caste-based reservation.

programme.title: Jaaneman
programme.desc: Suhaan, an aspiring actor, is in a fix when Piya files for divorce and forces him to pay a large amount as alimony. To avoid paying her, Suhaan uses Agastya's love for Piya and helps him woo her.

programme.title: Hum Aapke Dil Mein Rehte Hain
programme.desc: Not knowing what consequences she would face, a woman signs a 1-year marriage contract with a business tycoon to end her family's poverty.

programme.title: Tara Vs Bilal
programme.desc: Bilal, a carefree man, lives an easy-going life in London and falls in love with Tara, a sensitive woman, but is unable to express his feelings to her.

programme.title: Starfish
programme.desc: While working at a dredging company, a diver seeks out the truth behind a tragic loss, but an unexpected romance could help or hinder her search.

programme.title: Namastey London
programme.desc: On a trip to India, Jasmeet's father forcefully marries her off to Arjun. However, when they return to London, Jasmeet announces her intention of marrying her boyfriend, Charlie Brown.

programme.title: Laapataa Ladies
programme.desc: Two newlyweds find themselves inadvertently separated from their husbands moments after their respective weddings.

programme.title: Binny & Family
programme.desc: Rebellious teenage Binny and her conservative grandfather from Bihar connect after a dramatic incident. Can the contrasting personalities bridge generational gaps and impact each other's lives?

programme.title: Gunahon Ka Faisla
programme.desc: Vicky, a small-time criminal who must confront his past and decide between redemption or continuing his life of crime, while navigating loyalty and justice.

programme.title: Heyy Baby
programme.desc: Three men living in Australia are surprised to find a baby on their doorstep. They do not know who the father is and start a frantic search for the woman who could possibly be the mother.

programme.title: Tere Ishk Mein
programme.desc: Shankar and Mukti's intense love story unfolds against the backdrop of Benaras, exploring surrender and transformation that heals, hurts and changes them.

programme.title: Double Xl
programme.desc: Two plus-size women who are body-shamed, head to London to prove that dreams matter and challenge the societal norms for beauty.

programme.title: Kuch Naa Kaho
programme.desc: A secretary's manager tells her to find a match for his nephew who does not want to get married. The nephew rejects every proposal and falls in love with the secretary instead.

programme.title: Sardar Ka Grandson
programme.desc: A devoted grandson embarks on a complicated and comic journey to fulfill his ailing grandmother's last wish.

programme.title: Mister Mummy
programme.desc: A grumpy teacher and his kind wife clash on the subject of children, but a rare twist of fate leads them to connect in ways they never thought possible.

programme.title: Secret Superstar
programme.desc: Insia, an ambitious young girl, dreams of becoming a singer but faces opposition from her father. Undeterred, she strives to follow her passion by anonymously posting her songs on the Internet.

programme.title: Metro In Dino
programme.desc: The bittersweet stories of four urban-dwelling couples intertwine as they navigate the complexities and joys of relationships in modern-day India.

programme.title: Afwaah
programme.desc: A woman seeks to escape her engagement to a violent politician, but when a stranger comes to her aid, the two face an onslaught of bigotry and hate.

programme.title: Naseeb
programme.desc: When Pooja's father disapproves of her relation with Krishna, a humble man, he vows to become wealthy and returns to find that she is already married.

programme.title: Costao
programme.desc: In the 1990s, customs officer Costao Fernandes becomes a legend in Goa due to his bravery and tactics. His personal and professional life unravels when he kills a powerful drug lord in self-defence.

programme.title: Namastey London
programme.desc: On a trip to India, Jasmeet's father forcefully marries her off to Arjun. However, when they return to London, Jasmeet announces her intention of marrying her boyfriend, Charlie Brown.

programme.title: Firangi
programme.desc: In 1920 during India's freedom movement, one man firmly believes the British are not as bad as everyone believes.

programme.title: Love Break Up Zindagi
programme.desc: A couple and many of their friends experience changes and challenges in their respective lives after attending a wedding.

programme.title: Tere Pyar Mein
programme.desc: A photographer, while working on one of his assignments, comes across the backpack of a beautiful girl.

programme.title: Bhaiyya Ji
programme.desc: A man stands up for his family and seeks revenge for the wrongs done towards his loved ones.

programme.title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa 2
programme.desc: When strangers Reet and Ruhan cross paths, their journey leads to an abandoned mansion and a dreaded spirit who has been trapped for 18 years.
